notes: Missing Proxy Chains sidebar icon: — `GitBranch` was not imported or registered in `MasterPanel.tsx`'s `iconMap`, causing the Proxy Chains tab to render without an icon in the navigation sidebar. Added import and mapping. | Proxy Chains rename input focus reliability: — the focus call now wraps in `setTimeout(50ms)` to wait for the DOM render cycle. This is a fallback complement to the existing `autoFocus` attribute, ensuring focus lands even when React batches updates differently.
